Review_Text: The app updated and now it keeps crashing every time I try to send money. So frustrating.
Love the new app design, paying my friends is quick and easy. Great work.
Instant EFT reflected immediately, my supplier payment cleared in seconds. Excellent.
Queued for 45 minutes at month end just to draw my pension. Terrible experience.
My card was cloned at an ATM and money disappeared from my account. I am so angry about this.
Biometric login works flawlessly and the notifications are instant. Very impressed.
My instant EFT sat pending overnight and no one could tell me why. Really annoying.
The consultant helped me open a savings account for my daughter, warm and professional service.
Withdrew cash at the campus ATM, transaction took a few seconds. It was okay.
App down again during load shedding, third outage this month. Terrible for my business.
I struggle to read the small text in the app, and the update made it worse for older people like me.
Instant EFT is seamless, my allowance lands the second my parents send it. Love it.
ATM was out of cash the whole weekend, had to drive to three machines. Terrible inconvenience.
Month-end queue outside the door again. Staff are friendly but there are never enough tellers.
The app logged me out four times while I was trying to pay for data. Terrible and disappointing.
Payment I sent on Friday only cleared Monday. The delay messed up my debit orders. Not happy.
Cardless cash withdrawal worked first time at the ATM. Wonderful.
Went in to unblock my card, was in and out in ten minutes. Efficient staff, thank you.
Monthly fees increased again without any warning. This feels dishonest and I am disappointed.
All batch payments cleared same day with no hiccups. Excellent, reliable service.
The ATM kept my card on payday and I had to order a replacement. Disgusted with the bank.
The branch closes at 3pm now which is difficult, but the staff who helped me were kind and patient.
Dashboard shows my sales in real time, best banking app I have used in years.
I do not trust sending money on my phone, I prefer the branch. This EFT thing is confusing to me.
Used the ATM at the garage, R500 out, no issues to report.
App froze halfway through a transfer and I panicked. Money eventually went through but scary stuff.
Needed a bank letter, requested it online and collected same day. Smooth and simple.
EFT limit too low for my rent payment, had to split transfers across two days. Inconvenient.
Contactless tap on the card machine at the shops stopped working, had to insert and pin. Mildly annoying.
Whoever designed the latest app update should be ashamed. I cannot find my statements anymore. Frustrating.
Opened a business account in one visit, the consultant knew his products inside out. Impressive.
Transferred school fees instantly at 11pm and it reflected before I closed the app. Fantastic.
Weekly cash deposits at the ATM are quick and the slips are clear. No complaints.
The app crashed twice during load shedding while I was paying my exam fees. Terrible and unacceptable.
The branch moved to the other side of town without telling customers. Inconvenient for us who walk.
Sent my friend money for the braai, it arrived instantly. Fantastic and lekker.
The ATM rejected my card and I could not draw my pension. I left upset and angry.
Customer service replied on WhatsApp within a minute when my OTP did not arrive. Helpful people.
The security guard was rude when I asked for directions to the deposits counter. Disappointed.
The instant payment fee quietly increased, I only noticed on my statement. Sneaky and disappointing.
The app balance never matches my records and the call centre kept me waiting 20 minutes. So frustrating and exhausting.
